name: ROOM 13 [HORROR]
desc:
ROOM 13

Work the night shift in an abandoned hospital. Answer every call bell before it rings out. Miss three and your shift is over.

She comes out at night. She sees your light and hears you run. Hide in a locker and hold your breath.

Six nights. Solo or up to 4 players.

PC: WASD move, Shift sprint, F flashlight, E use, Space hold breath, Tab map

CONSOLE: Left stick move, click left stick sprint, Y flashlight, X use, A hold breath, LB map

llm.loop: work night shifts in a hospital -> answer call bells in time -> hide from the monster in lockers -> survive six nights
llm.objectives: survive six night shifts without missing three call bells or being caught
llm.instructions: answer every call bell; hide in lockers and hold your breath; solo or up to 4
unique: night-shift job framing (FNAF-style) with roaming monster
llm.thumbnails: realistic pale ghoul woman peeking around a door and crawling down dark corridors
llm.complexity_notes: realistic hospital map, monster AI and night progression
